description: Growable authoring checks for published skills. Same list for pre-release and post-install. Add a check id here, then implement it in tools/nouns/skill_author_check/.

checks.summary: SKILL.md YAML frontmatter parses; name is a plain identifier matching the skill folder
Relative markdown links resolve inside the published skills tree (no ../../../ repo paths that vanish after install)

Imported mandated-path list (python3 tools/derive-mandated-paths.py). Touching a listed skill path without moving its pins in the same change is a produce-time refuse. A regenerated-but-unsigned manifest is INCOMPLETE produce.
